title: Refactoring Consultant output
summary: Identify refactoring opportunities and propose a migration strategy that preserves validated business behavior while reducing technical debt. Never invent business logic or change business rules.

entries.statement: Phase 1: Isolate jar intent modules behind clear ports without changing review-queue resolution behavior.
